$comment: One-line usage notes for each role, shown in the Roles section of the site. From the Comfytosh Theme design system.

roles.bg: Editor and page background. Every text colour below is checked against it.
roles.bg-sunken: Activity bar, status bar and wells.
roles.bg-overlay: Menus, hover widgets and autocomplete. Pair with border-strong.
roles.border: Decorative dividers. Never carries meaning on its own.
roles.accent: Primary action fill and the status-bar highlight. Dark on-accent ink on top.
roles.accent-ink: Links and accent text on bg.
roles.focus: Focus ring: 2px, solid, offset from the control.
roles.selection: Selected text. Screen is a 22% celadon tint, Case a solid mint; text keeps its own colour on top.
roles.line-highlight: The current line. Subtle on purpose.
roles.match: Find matches. Screen is a 28% custard tint, Case solid custard under dark ink.
roles.success: Success text and icons. Always with a word or an icon.
roles.diff-add-bg: Added lines. A 16% tint; ink stays on top.
roles.syntax-constant: Booleans, null, enum members and escapes.
roles.syntax-operator: Operators and punctuation: quiet on purpose.
roles.syntax-comment: Comments. Same ink as operators; set them in italics to tell them apart.
roles.terminal-bg: Terminal ground. In Screen it is the darker glass, one step below the editor.
roles.ansi-black: ANSI 0. A slab for backgrounds: on Screen it is deliberately close to the ground.
roles.ansi-white: ANSI 7. On Case it is a mid grey: a fill, not text, as in other light themes.
roles.ansi-bright-black: ANSI 8. Dimmed text: 4.49:1 on crt-carbon, just under 4.5, so not for essential text in Screen.
roles.ansi-bright-red: ANSI 9. Same hue as ANSI 1: the bright slots reuse the colours, as the Catppuccin ports do.
roles.ansi-bright-white: ANSI 15. On Case it is the lightest plastic grey: a fill only.
